claim.claim-text: 1. A crystalline form of the compound of formula I,

in an X-ray powder diffraction pattern of the crystalline form with Cu Kα radiation thereof, diffraction peaks are present at 20 angles of about 7.44, 8.93, 10.44 and 17.84 degrees, preferably diffraction peaks present at about 7.44, 8.93, 10.26, 10.44, 10.70, 11.17, 12.65, 12.96, 14.35, 15.49, 16.34, 17.84, 18.28, 18.73, 20.96, 21.88, 22.42, 23.03, 24.17, 25.27 and 26.16 degrees, and most preferably diffraction peaks present at about 7.44, 8.93, 9.48, 10.26, 10.44, 10.70, 11.17, 11.85, 12.65, 12.96, 13.57, 14.35, 15.49, 15.75, 16.34, 17.84, 18.28, 18.73, 19.43, 20.02, 20.65, 20.96, 21.88, 22.42, 23.03, 24.17, 25.27, 25.99, 26.16 and 29.24 degrees.
2. The crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 1, wherein the crystalline form has endothermic peaks at about 125.70°C and 174.07°C.
3. A method for preparing the crystalline form according to claim 1 or 2, comprising the following steps of:
4. A crystalline form of the compound of formula I,

in an X-ray powder diffraction pattern of the crystalline form with Cu Kα radiation thereof, diffraction peaks are present at 2θ angles of about 7.38, 10.33 and 17.84 degrees, preferably diffraction peaks present at about 7.38, 8.80, 10.33, 11.15, 15.30, 17.84, 18.18, 19.76, 21.03 and 21.86 degrees, and most preferably diffraction peaks present at about 7.38, 8.80, 10.33, 11.15, 11.71, 12.33, 12.58, 12.88, 13.50, 14.28, 15.30, 16.04, 16.33, 16.55, 17.84, 18.18, 18.43, 19.76, 21.03, 21.86, 22.83, 25.34 and 25.86 degrees.
5. The crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 4, wherein the crystalline form has endothermic peaks at about 174.16°C.
6. A method for preparing the crystalline form according to claim 4 or 5, comprising the following steps of:
7. A crystalline form of the compound of formula I,
8. The crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 7, wherein the crystalline form has endothermic peaks at about 174.14°C.
9. A method for preparing the crystalline form according to claim 7 or 8, comprising the following steps of:
10. A crystalline form of the compound of formula I,

in an X-ray powder diffraction pattern of the crystalline form with Cu Kα radiation thereof, diffraction peaks are present at 20 angles of about 4.51, 6.64 and 10.66 degrees, preferably diffraction peaks present at about 4.51, 6.64, 9.03, 9.64, 10.66, 16.69 and 17.12 degrees, more preferably diffraction peaks present at about 4.51, 6.64, 9.03, 9.64, 10.66, 13.26, 13.59, 15.20, 15.85, 16.69, 17.12, 19.33, 20.49, 22.12, and 22.50 degrees, and most preferably diffraction peaks present at about 4.51, 6.64, 9.03, 9.64, 10.66, 13.26, 13.59, 14.40, 15.20, 15.85, 16.69, 17.12, 17.36, 18.10, 19.33, 20.49, 21.38, 22.12, and 22.50 degrees.
11. The crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 10, wherein the crystalline form has endothermic peaks at about 136.34°C.
12. A method for preparing the crystalline form according to claim 10 or 11, comprising the following steps of:
13. A crystalline composition comprising a crystalline form of the compound of formula I,

wherein the crystalline form of the compound of formula I accounts for more than 50% by weight of the crystalline composition, preferably more than 80%, more preferably more than 90 %, or most preferably more than 95%, wherein the crystalline form of the compound of formula I is the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 1, the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 4, the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 7 or the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 10, or mixtures thereof.
14. A pharmaceutical composition comprising a therapeutically effective amount of a crystalline form of the compound of formula I, or the crystallineline composition according to claim 13,

wherein the crystalline form of the compound of formula I is the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 1, the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 4, the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 7 or the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 10, or mixtures thereof.

15. A crystalline form of the compound of formula I, or the crystalline composition according to claim 13, or the pharmaceutical composition according to claim 14 for use in the treating and/or preventing of diseases mediated by c-Met kinase,

wherein the crystalline form of the compound of formula I is the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 1, the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 4, the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 7 or the crystalline form of the compound of formula I according to claim 10, or mixtures thereof; preferably, wherein the disease mediated by c-Met kinase is cancer; more preferably, wherein the disease mediated by c-Met kinase is lung cancer.
